purpose: TransitionPlan for the uat_seed_accounts table — a UAT/dev-only control table used by CustomerAuthService to authenticate test users with a static OTP, without real OTP delivery.
businessRules: Returns a static TransitionPlan via transitionPlan() factory method.
Initial transition: fromVersions=[-1] to toVersion=0 (table creation).
Called by V1__Schema in the customer identity group alongside CustomerAccountsMigration and CustomerAuthIdentitiesMigration.
The table is only meaningful in local/dev/uat profiles; CustomerAuthService guards usage with environment profile checks.
DatabaseSeeder also issues CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS uat_seed_accounts on every boot so the table is safe to use even on DBs where V1 ran before this plan was added.
Rows are seeded by DatabaseSeeder.seedDevAuthAccounts() from auth/dev-accounts.json using the otp_code field.

CustomerAuthService joins: uat_seed_accounts → customer_accounts (via identity_email = primary_email) → customer_auth_identities (via customer_id). All three tables must have matching rows for login to succeed.
